panels.title: In one sentence
panels.description:
The VA's engine, features adopted of the six, playbooks live and idle, and executions. Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.va_adoption, n360.v_va_feature_adoption  
**Filter:** VA  
**Window:** the 31 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, concat(any(a.va), ' on ', ifNull(any(a.engine_version), 'an unread engine'), ' · ',
                   toString(any(c.n)), ' of 6 features · ', toString(any(a.playbooks_live)), ' playbooks live',
                   if(any(a.idle_playbooks) > 0, concat(', ', toString(any(a.idle_playbooks)), ' idle'), ''), ' · ',
                   if(any(a.executions) IS NULL, NULL, if(any(a.executions) >= 1000000, concat(toString(intDiv(any(a.executions), 1000000)), ',', leftPad(toString(intDiv(any(a.executions), 1000) % 1000), 3, '0'), ',', leftPad(toString(any(a.executions) % 1000), 3, '0')), if(any(a.executions) >= 1000, concat(toString(intDiv(any(a.executions), 1000)), ',', leftPad(toString(any(a.executions) % 1000), 3, '0')), toString(any(a.executions))))), ' executions in 31 days')) AS sentence
        FROM n360.va_adoption AS a
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT bot_id, countIf(state = 'adopted') AS n FROM n360.v_va_feature_adoption GROUP BY bot_id) AS c ON c.bot_id = a.bot_id
        WHERE toString(a.bot_id) IN (${va:singlequote})

panels.title: Data
panels.description:
The last day of usage in this load, and the day it was loaded. Amber when the data is more than 2 days old (n360.settings stamp_stale_days): the numbers are the last good night's. Click for Pipeline health.

**Source:** n360.v_freshness (n360.runs: loaded runs only)  
**Filter:** none  
**Window:** the latest load

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(stamp, if(stale, concat(' · ', toString(days_old), ' days old'), '')) AS stamp FROM n360.v_freshness

panels.title: Handed off from a playbook
panels.description:
Handoffs to an agent from within a playbook, as a share of the conversations that ran one. Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.va_adoption  
**Filter:** VA  
**Window:** the 31 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(any(conversations) = 0, NULL, round(100 * any(handoffs) / any(conversations), 1)) AS `of those conversations`
        FROM n360.va_adoption WHERE toString(bot_id) IN (${va:singlequote})

panels.title: Cortex
panels.description:
Used to create or edit a production playbook in the last 30 days. Cortex is read for US VAs only and has no user id: whether Netomi or the customer ran a session is not known yet. Green adopted, amber partly, light grey not yet, grey not reported. The evidence is in the table below. Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_va_feature_adoption  
**Filter:** VA  
**Window:** the newest read

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(state, '|', value) AS v FROM n360.v_va_feature_adoption WHERE toString(bot_id) IN (${va:singlequote}) AND feature = 'Cortex'

panels.title: Executions by playbook
panels.description:
Every production playbook on this VA by executions over 31 days (an idle one shows 0). Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_playbook  
**Filter:** VA  
**Window:** the newest read

targets.rawSql: SELECT playbook AS Playbook, executions AS Executions FROM n360.v_playbook WHERE toString(bot_id) IN (${va:singlequote}) ORDER BY ifNull(executions, 0) DESC

panels.title: Length against traffic
panels.description:
Each playbook on this VA as a point: instruction length across, executions up. Hover a point for the playbook. Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_playbook  
**Filter:** VA  
**Window:** the newest read

targets.rawSql:
SELECT instruction_chars AS `Instructions (characters)`, executions AS `Executions, 31 days`, playbook AS Playbook
        FROM n360.v_playbook WHERE toString(bot_id) IN (${va:singlequote}) AND executions IS NOT NULL ORDER BY instruction_chars

panels.title: Every playbook on this VA
panels.description:
Every production playbook on this VA: sizes, length band, executions and their share of the VA, whether it ran, who built it, and its task id (to find it in the product). Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_playbook  
**Filter:** VA  
**Window:** the newest read

targets.rawSql:
SELECT playbook AS Playbook, length_band AS Length, instruction_chars AS `Instructions (characters)`, tools AS Tools,
               trigger_chars AS `Trigger (characters)`, if(short, 'yes', 'no') AS `Short (<200)`,
               executions AS `Executions, 31 days`, share_of_va_pct AS `Share of the VA`,
               multiIf(idle IS NULL, NULL, idle, 'Idle', 'Ran') AS `In use`, ifNull(built_by, '') AS `Built by`, task_id AS Task
        FROM n360.v_playbook WHERE toString(bot_id) IN (${va:singlequote}) ORDER BY rank_on_va

panels.title: Playbooks and legacy intents, week by week
panels.description:
At each weekly configuration read: V8 playbooks (solid) and legacy intents still configured (dashed). The migration is done when the dashed line reaches 0.

**Source:** n360.va_config_snapshot  
**Filter:** VA  
**Window:** dashboard time range, weekly reads

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(snapshot_date) AS time, any(v8_playbooks) AS `V8 playbooks`, any(legacy_intents) AS `Legacy intents`
        FROM n360.va_config_snapshot WHERE toString(bot_id) IN (${va:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(snapshot_date) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Engine, week by week
panels.description:
The engine version at each weekly read: green V8 or later, amber older. Hover for the version.

**Source:** n360.va_config_snapshot  
**Filter:** VA  
**Window:** dashboard time range, weekly reads

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(snapshot_date) AS time, engine_version AS Engine
        FROM n360.va_config_snapshot WHERE toString(bot_id) IN (${va:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(snapshot_date) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Configuration, VA by VA
panels.description:
Per VA, the v1.1 configuration table: engine and playbooks, legacy intents left, idle playbooks, calibration, Behavior Validation and test runs, recipes live and their write actions, MCP servers (live, set up but not live, names) and supervisory rules (live, default). Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.va_adoption  
**Filter:** VA  
**Window:** the newest read

targets.rawSql:
SELECT va AS VA, engine_version AS Engine, playbooks_live AS `Playbooks live`, legacy_intents AS `Legacy intents`,
               idle_playbooks AS Idle,
               concat(toString(ifNull(calibration_runs, 0)), if(calibration_runs = 1, ' run, ', ' runs, '),
                      toString(ifNull(calibration_completed, 0)), ' completed') AS Calibration,
               concat(toString(toDayOfMonth(calibration_last)), ' ', formatDateTime(calibration_last, '%b %Y')) AS `Last calibrated`, ifNull(behavior_validation, 'not set') AS `Behavior Validation`,
               test_runs AS `Test runs`, concat(toString(ifNull(recipes_production, 0)), ' of ', toString(ifNull(recipes, 0)), ' live') AS Recipes,
               recipe_actions AS `Write actions`,
               concat(toString(ifNull(mcp_live, 0)), ' live', if(ifNull(mcp_not_live, 0) > 0, concat(', ', toString(mcp_not_live), ' set up, not live'), '')) AS `MCP servers`,
               mcp_names AS `MCP names`,
               concat(toString(ifNull(supervisory_live, 0)), ' live, ', toString(ifNull(supervisory_default, 0)), ' default') AS `Supervisory rules`,
               supervisory_names AS `Rule names`, toString(bot_id) AS bot, account
        FROM n360.va_adoption WHERE toString(bot_id) IN (${va:singlequote}) ORDER BY VA
